title: Year 8 retrieval quiz
subject: Mathematics
source: Seeded from mathematics/y8 lesson 85 (Year 8 retrieval quiz (portal))
intro: Covers lessons 70 to 85 of Data handling and averages. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: After a 25% reduction a coat costs £60. Original?
A price after a 40% increase is £56. Original?
Which is a testable hypothesis?
options: Year 8 pupils sleep more than 8 hours on school nights
questions.a: A) Year 8 pupils sleep more than 8 hours on school nights. It names a group and a measurable claim.

questions.q: Which sample is most likely to be fair?
options: 20 names picked at random from the whole school list
The first 20 pupils to log on
questions.a: A) 20 names picked at random from the whole school list. Random selection from the whole population; the others favour certain pupils.

questions.q: Which classes have a problem?
questions.a: A) 0-10, 10-20, 20-30. Using 0-10 and 10-20 leaves 10 in two classes.

questions.q: A graph's axis goes 0, 10, 20, 50, 100. The problem is:
questions.a: A) unequal steps. Steps of 10, 10, 30, 50 distort the bars.
A) 8. Total 40 ÷ 5 = 8. 6 is the median.

questions.q: Mean of 3 numbers is 9. Two are 7 and 8. The third:
A smaller range means the data is:
questions.a: A) more consistent. Values are closer together.

questions.q: Best average for the most common dress size?
questions.a: A) mode. Shops stock the size sold most often.

questions.q: Values 1, 2, 3 with frequencies 2, 5, 2. The median is:
questions.a: A) 2. 9 values: the 5th is in the '2' row (running totals 2, 7).

questions.q: Values 1, 2, 3 with frequencies 3, 4, 3. The mean:
Why is the mean only an estimate?
options: We use midpoints, not the real values
The classes are too big to add
questions.a: A) We use midpoints, not the real values. Grouping hides the exact values.

questions.q: 6.2 × 10⁻³ as an ordinary number:
questions.a: A) 0.0062. Move the digits 3 places right of the point: 0.0062.

questions.q: A reverse percentage needs you to:
questions.a: A) divide by the multiplier

questions.q: Spaced practice means:
questions.a: A) a little, often

questions.q: The stage after collecting data is:
questions.a: A) process and represent

questions.q: A random sample means:
questions.a: A) everyone has the same chance
options: you ask the first people you see

questions.q: Continuous data is:
questions.a: A) measured

questions.q: A truncated axis:
questions.a: A) does not start at zero
